title: CMMC 8-Step Interactive Journey
description: Interactive 8-step CMMC milestone journey with walking assessor SVG and fully editable steps.

title.default: Your CMMC journey, step by step

step1Help.default: In-person physical & technical walkthrough of facilities, server rooms, and shop-floor enclaves.

step2Help.default: Map CUI/FCI flows, identify perimeter and boundary points, and define your assessment scope.

step2Output.default: Formal CUI Boundary & Data Flow Diagram

step3Help.default: Score your current posture against all 110 NIST SP 800-171 requirements with objective evidence.

step3Output.default: Initial SPRS Score & Detailed Gap Matrix

step4Help.default: Actionable, engineer-to-engineer remediation roadmap with prioritized sprints and cost estimates.

step5Phase.default: Phase 3: System Security Plan (SSP) & Policy Authoring

step5Help.default: We author your comprehensive, audit-tested System Security Plan (SSP) and operational procedures.

step6Phase.default: Phase 3: Mock C3PAO Assessment & Pre-Audit Audit

step6Help.default: Full mock assessment simulating actual DIBCAC or C3PAO assessor interviews, testing evidence defensibility.

step7Phase.default: Phase 4: Official C3PAO / DIBCAC Certification Audit

step7Help.default: We sit shoulder-to-shoulder with your team during the official C3PAO assessment, defending your SSP and evidence.

step7Output.default: Official CMMC Level 2 Audit Pass with Zero Open Items

step8Help.default: Ongoing continuous monitoring, incident response drills, annual affirmation filings, and vCISO support.

step8Output.default: Year-Round Continuous CMMC Compliance & Audit Defense
